title: Expedition 33 Best Builds - All Characters Guide
description: Best builds for all 6 characters in Expedition 33 including Gustave, Lune, Maelle, Sciel, Verso, and Monoco with skills, weapons, and Pictos.

sections.title: Build System Overview
sections.content:
Expedition 33 offers deep build customization through the combination of Skills, Weapons, Pictos, and Lumina. Each character has a unique combat mechanic that defines their optimal playstyle.

Build Components

  • Skills (6 equipped): Choose from each character's full skill pool. These define your combat actions.
  • Weapons: Provide stat scaling (D through S rank), elemental damage, and passive bonuses at upgrade milestones.
  • Pictos (3 equipped): Passive stat boosts and special effects. After 4 battles, unlock the Lumina effect for all characters.
  • Lumina Points: Equip unlocked Pictos effects to any character. Stack multiple for powerful combos.
  • Attributes: Distribute 3 points per level among Vitality, Might, Agility, Defense, and Luck.

The best builds leverage synergies between these systems — a weapon that complements a character's mechanic, Pictos that amplify their strengths, and skills that chain together for maximum output.

sections.title: Gustave Build — Overcharge DPS
sections.content:
Gustave is the main protagonist and a reliable damage dealer who builds Overcharge through attacks. His optimal build maximizes Overcharge generation and Mark application to set up devastating blows.

Core Mechanic: Overcharge

Gustave accumulates Overcharge through his sword attacks and certain skills. At maximum Overcharge, his next attack deals massively amplified damage. The goal is to cycle between building Overcharge and releasing it for burst damage.

Recommended Skills

  • Lumiere Assault: Multi-hit combo (up to 5 hits) — excellent for breaking shields and building Overcharge
  • Marking Shot: Apply Mark to enemies so other party members deal bonus damage
  • Overcharge Release: Unleash stored Overcharge for massive single-target damage

Best Weapons

  • Lanceram: Excellent early-game option with solid power. Found by defeating a Lancelier in Spring Meadows or purchased at higher level from the Cruler in Coastal Cave (21,275 Chroma).

Key Pictos

  • Energising Start I-IV (extra AP at battle start)
  • Augmented Counter I-III (powerful counterattacks)
  • Full Strength (flat damage increase)

Attribute Focus

Might > Luck > Agility. Gustave benefits from raw attack power and critical chance to maximize his Overcharge burst turns.

sections.title: Lune Build — Elemental Stain Mage
sections.content:
Lune is the party's elemental spellcaster and healer. She generates Stains in combat that enhance subsequent spells. The best Lune builds combo Stains for amplified damage while keeping the party alive.

Core Mechanic: Elemental Stains

Lune creates elemental Stains (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark) through attacks and skills. These Stains power up specific abilities — more Stains mean more damage. Weapons like Trebuchim generate random Stains on Free Aim shots for even faster stacking.

Recommended Skills

  • Immolation: Applies Burn to enemies — synergizes with Maelle's Swift Strike
  • Elemental Genesis: Consumes Stains for massive damage scaling
  • Elemental Trick: Cheaply creates 4 Stains for combo setup
  • Rockslide: Strong Break skill for stunning enemies
  • Healing/Revive skills: Lune is the best party healer

Best Weapons

  • Trebuchim: Generates random Stains on Free Aim shots. Found from Catapult Sakapatate in Ancient Sanctuary or Gestral Arena (as Lune).
  • Snowim: Life-saving sustain weapon. Restores Health, provides Stains and AP. Found from Gargant in Frozen Hearts or Flying Manor.
  • Esquim: Convert Stains to Dark, then deal 300% more damage. Found in Paint Cage in Verso's Drafts.
  • Cleim: Endgame powerhouse. Ethereal sword deals extra damage per skill used, double damage with stacked Stains. From Clea Unleashed in Endless Tower.

Synergy

Lune using Immolation into Maelle's Swift Strike (enters Virtuose Stance on first turn) is one of the strongest early-game combos in the game.

sections.title: Maelle Build — Virtuose Stance DPS
sections.content:
Maelle is a fencer who switches between three Stances. The best builds keep her in Virtuose Stance as much as possible while stacking damage multipliers to one-shot enemies.

Core Mechanic: Battle Stance

  • Defensive Stance: Reduces damage taken, gains 1 AP on parry/dodge
  • Offensive Stance: Deals more damage but takes more
  • Virtuose Stance: Maximum damage output with no relevant downside

Switching between any stance grants +1 AP. The goal is reaching Virtuose Stance quickly and staying there.

Recommended Skills

  • Fencer's Flurry: AoE that applies Defenseless to all enemies — ideal opening move
  • Sword Ballet: Boss-killing nuke with incredible scaling on Luck/Crit builds
  • Phantom Strike: Late-game AoE nuke for clearing groups
  • Guard Up: Party-wide Shell for defensive support

Best Weapons

  • Medalum: Starts Maelle in Virtuose Stance every fight. From Gestral Arena (as Maelle). Essential early game.
  • Jarum: Stacks Burn, switches to Virtuose on counterattack. From Chromatic Jar west of Gestral Village.
  • Lithum: Capitalizes on Marked enemies, Virtuose on counterattack. From defeating Alicia in The Reacher (Maelle relationship level 5).

Key Synergies

Pair with Verso or Sciel for extra AP generation. Lune's Immolation + Maelle's Burn skills create devastating damage loops. Equip Powerful On Shell Lumina with Guard Up for party-wide damage buffs.

sections.title: Sciel Build — Foretell / Twilight AoE
sections.content:
Sciel uses tarot-style cards to apply Foretell stacks on enemies, making them increasingly vulnerable. Her strongest builds revolve around entering and maintaining Twilight for devastating area damage.

Core Mechanic: Foretell & Twilight

Foretell stacks make enemies take more damage from all sources. Twilight is Sciel's empowered state where her AoE damage becomes extraordinary. The key is entering Twilight quickly and dealing damage before it expires.

Recommended Skills

  • Sealed Fate: Critical Hits don't remove Foretell from enemies — essential for sustained damage
  • Sun Skills: Build Twilight charge and deal solid damage
  • AoE Twilight skills: Massive damage to all enemies while in Twilight state

Best Weapons

  • Charnon: 100% Crit in Twilight, applies Foretell on crits, +20% stacking damage per turn without taking damage. Purchased from Grour in Renoir's Drafts.
  • Tisseron: Increases Twilight damage with Sun Skills, grants extra turn on Twilight entry. Earned from defeating Sirene in the story.

Party Role

Sciel is a pure DPS character. She works best with a healer like Lune actively supporting her, since Twilight builds require staying alive through multiple turns. Not ideal as your only damage dealer early on, but becomes devastating in the mid-to-late game.

sections.title: Verso Build — Perfection Rank Damage
sections.content:
Verso joins in Act 2 as an enigmatic fighter who gains Perfection through attacking and successful defenses. Higher Rank means more damage, but taking hits reduces Rank — making skilled play essential.

Core Mechanic: Perfection Rank (D→S)

Verso builds Rank by attacking, using skills, and Dodging/Parrying. At S-Rank, his damage is fully unlocked and many skills gain bonuses. Taking damage drops Rank, so mastering defensive timing is crucial.

Three Weapon Builds

  • Gaulteram (Standard DPS): Provides a different element from Verso's Physical/Light skills. Straightforward damage build.
  • Dualiso (Double Turn): From Dualliste boss. Low base damage but effectively grants 2 turns. First turn builds Rank; second turn nukes with Phantom Stars.
  • Sireso (Support): From Axon Sirene. Verso no longer gains personal damage from Rank — instead provides damage bonus to all allies. Build to S-Rank, then spam Powerful and Marking Shot.

Key Skills

  • Light Holder: Strong Rank builder with solid damage (functionally costs 2 AP)
  • Phantom Stars: One of Verso's strongest S-Rank AoE skills
  • Marking Shot: Sets up massive damage for other party members
  • Powerful: Party-wide buff lasting 5 turns at A-Rank

Attribute Focus

Agility + Luck. Verso gains extra Perfection on critical hits, making crit chance exceptionally valuable for maintaining S-Rank.

sections.title: Monoco Build — Bestial Wheel Flex
sections.content:
Monoco is a Gestral who transforms into enemies using his Bestial Wheel. He's the most flexible character, capable of taking the form of the strongest foes you've defeated.

Core Mechanic: Bestial Wheel

Monoco can transform into various enemy forms encountered throughout your journey. Each transformation grants access to that enemy's abilities, making his power scale with how many bosses you've defeated.

Two Playstyles

DPS Build

Transform into the strongest enemies available. Late-game transformations deal massive damage that rivals dedicated DPS characters. Prioritize defeating optional bosses to unlock more powerful forms.

Support Build

  • Potier Energy: Generate AP for your entire party — makes Monoco an incredible support
  • Upgraded Skills with Ballaro: AP generation for allies when using Upgraded Skills

Best Weapon

  • Ballaro: Level 10 and 20 passives provide AP to all party members when using Upgraded Skills. Transforms Monoco into a party-wide AP battery — freeing your DPS characters to use expensive abilities every turn.

Party Role

Monoco is best as either a dedicated support (AP generation) or a secondary DPS filling gaps in your team's elemental coverage. He's less specialized than other characters, making him ideal for adapting to specific boss weaknesses.
